svg.title: How the motion planner is packaged and called
svg.desc: One OS process, scheduler_node, holds the ROS component, SchedulerRos with the plan service, the Scheduler library and the motion_planner shared library. A plan request runs synchronously on one thread from the service callback through task planning and CHUGG and back. Below: the package dependencies and what would change if the motion planner became a separate node.

g.text: The motion planner is a shared library linked into the scheduler node, not a node of its own. A plan request runs on one thread, synchronously, from the plan service callback through task planning (which calls the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: single-agent searches) and CHUGG (built fresh for each call) and back to the service response.
